items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New dedicated License Requests page in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
items.description: We are introducing a new dedicated License Requests page in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center to help admins more easily discover, review, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests submitted by users.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Web App
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint just as you open the PowerPoint web app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
items.description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
items.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Shadow AI
items.description: Currently admins can set Purview DLP policies to protect sensitive data from being sent to any Generative AI apps, users get blocked from sending their prompts to LLM when this is triggered and stops their workflow. This new add-on to the feature shows a new UI that will give users the option to be redirected to M365 Copilot which will open and navigate to this M365 Copilot tab and allow them to send the same prompt there.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS
items.description: Access Copilot directly when previewing files in Outlook. Tap the Copilot button to get smart suggestions, summaries, and answers about your documents without leaving the previewer. Get quick help understanding attachments and files right when you need it.

items.title: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
items.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every change.

items.title: Outlook: Account Selector in Outlook Copilot Side Pane
items.description: When users have more than one Copilot-enabled account added to new Outlook, the Copilot side pane in Calendar will include an account dropdown that makes it clear which Copilot-enabled account you’re using and lets you switch accounts without relying on Outlook UI’s account context.

items.title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
items.description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Flux, or Auto for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.

items.title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
items.description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Black Forest Lab’s Flux and Microsoft’s MAI-Image and more, for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.

items.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
items.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
items.description: Recording and transcript owners can now grant recording and transcript access to specified people when copying or sharing recap link, and the specified people can access the recap without having to request access.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Excel spreadsheets from Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks allows users to generate Excel spreadsheets using the content and references gathered in a notebook. Copilot drafts a structured spreadsheet grounded in the notebook’s context, which can be opened and edited in Excel, helping users move from ideas and source material to a ready‑to‑use spreadsheet with fewer manual steps.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
items.description: Copilot now provides coaching feedback on email drafts via chat and can apply suggestions directly to your message in Outlook. Users have the option to choose which suggestions are applied, and Copilot updates your email in place.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Companion apps - Copilot prompts in the Files app now available for Copilot Chat users
items.description: The Files companion app, part of the Microsoft 365 companion apps suite on the Windows taskbar, now surfaces AI-powered Copilot file prompts for Copilot Chat users. Previously available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensees, this update extends contextual file prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users, enabling them to discover and interact with relevant files through intelligent suggestions. Users can find their most relevant files faster and take action on them directly from the Files app.

items.title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
items.description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Flux, or Auto for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
items.description: We are introducing a refreshed chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app, bringing a cleaner, more intuitive interface to users. This update includes a modernized design language, streamlined navigation, and other improvements that make it easier and faster for users to start, continue, and manage chats on the mobile app.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (iPhone)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. Other endpoints coming soon.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Mind Maps in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Mind Maps in Copilot Notebooks are interactive visual artifacts that help users understand notebook content through a grounded map of key topics, themes, and relationships. Users can explore the Mind Map, view summaries for individual nodes, and use Notebook chat to get more detail about a node. Available across OneNote and Microsoft 365 Copilot App.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create PowerPoint presentations from Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks enables users to generate PowerPoint presentations directly from the content and references collected in a notebook. Using the notebook’s curated context, Copilot creates a structured, editable slide deck that users can open and refine in PowerPoint, helping turn research, notes, and insights into shareable presentations more quickly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Word documents from Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks allows users to generate Word documents using the content and references gathered in a notebook. Copilot drafts a structured document grounded in the notebook’s context, which can be opened and edited in Word, helping users move from ideas and source material to a ready‑to‑use document with fewer manual steps.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Choose Anthropic models when editing with Copilot in Word
items.description: You can choose to select Anthropic models, in addition to OpenAI models, when editing a Word document using Copilot.

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
items.description: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Copilot New Tab Page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the new, refreshed Copilot New Tab Page. Users can also view personalized news and activities.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
items.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Submit agent to Agent Store from Agent Builder
items.description: Customers can submit their custom Copilot agents built in Agent Builder to the Agent Store under the "Built by your org" section, after admin review and approval in M365 Admin Center. This governed flow enables admins to review, approve, and publish submitted agents so that they can be discovered and used by others in the Agent Store. This helps organizations share validated agents at scale while maintaining quality and governance.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
items.description: Consecutive interpretation enables turn-based interpretation for everyone in the meeting. Interpretation happens after each speaker finishes talking, creating a turn-based flow that supports interactive discussions across two languages.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Surveys Agent and Copilot Chat in Microsoft Forms
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now integrated in Microsoft Forms, including enabling the Surveys Agent from within Forms. Surveys Agent provides specialized capabilities to help with your form - from recommending and applying improvements to your form or quiz, to helping draft and send invitations, to analyzing your results. Surveys Agent is available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and can be accessed by clicking the "Copilot" icon in Forms.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
items.description: When users insert content in a prompt using 'Add Work Content' under the Plus menu, the content will only appear as a pill in the Input Box UI and will not be repeated as part of the user's prompt. This helps to simplify the Input Box and reserve it for prompt creation. Updated April 22, 2026: We are moving this item back to In Development and will be relaunching after further updates. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
items.description:
This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors.

For Confluence Cloud connector, it introduces simplified options to filter pages by page id, creation date/time and last update date/time, helping improve productivity and reduce human errors.

For Confluence On-premises connector, it adds support for advanced CQL-based filtering, enabling more complex and flexible filtering scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft Edge can now send work related browsing history to Copilot for more relevant work results when searching on M365 Copilot search
items.description: Microsoft Edge can now send IT admin selected work related browsing history to Copilot to improve search relevance. When a user searches for something on Copilot search, Copilot will also show results from browser history when relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage private content in M365 Copilot
items.description: Engage content from private communities and events will be used as grounding source for M365 Copilot. When a user queries in M365 Copilot, they will only be able to see content they are privileged to access.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Onboarding emails for Leaders
items.description: This feature introduces automated, role-targeted onboarding emails for Leaders to drive discovery of the Copilot Dashboard in Viva insights.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Web Link as a Reference in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Add web links as references in your Copilot Notebooks.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
items.description: Use the tools menu in Copilot Chat to co-create content or code with Copilot in a Page and share with others when ready.

items.title: Microsoft CoPilot (Microsoft 365): List email attachments in M365 Copilot
items.description: Users will be able to list the file attachments that they received or sent over email in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins will be able to define rules to automate agent lifecycle management.
items.description:
Admins will have the ability to set up rules for various scenarios, such as -

1. Auto block risky agents.
2. Auto delete inactive agents.
3. Auto reassign ownerless agents to manager. 

. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Pulse - Authoring with M365 Copilot
items.description: Viva Pulse authors can now work with M365 Copilot to add a question, rewrite a question, and create a survey from scratch to quickly create and send their surveys to their teams to collect feedback. M365 Copilot can seamlessly capture the author's needs to recommend survey questions that fit their unique scenario. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
items.description: Users can chat one-on-one with a SharePoint agent directly within Teams chat.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
items.description:
Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications.
Governance policy checks serve as configurable safeguards that review AI‑generated and autonomous email responses before they are sent to customers. These checks enforce business, legal, and regulatory requirements by validating responses for relevance, prohibited content, and sensitive topics. If a response fails a policy check, delivery is blocked and the violation is clearly identified, enabling supervisors to review issues and take actions to improve outcomes.
Governance policies are applied consistently across email engagement channels and seamlessly embedded within agent workflows, ensuring uniform enforcement of quality and compliance standards without requiring manual intervention. This approach empowers organizations to scale AI-assisted and autonomous customer engagement with confidence while upholding trust, safety, and governance.
Business Value:
Governance policies give you control over AI-driven customer interactions. By setting clear, configurable rules, you make sure every response meets your business, legal, and regulatory standards before it reaches customers. This reduces risk, protects your brand, and keeps communication consistent and trustworthy.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Service representative experiences - Use pinned contacts and queues during consult and transfer
items.description:
In the Copilot Service admin center, administrators configure and manage pinned contacts and queues for representatives as follows:

Enable pins in the Customer settings > Manage pins > Admin pins page so that representatives pin their contacts and queues.
Pin specific contacts and queues for representatives.
Display pinned items to representatives based on business units.

Business Value:
This feature streamlines your team’s workflow by removing the hassle of tracking multiple consult and transfer targets, so that your service representatives focus on delivering faster, more reliable support.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
items.description:
In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the (workflow) approval system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.
The APIs are read-only and allow querying for:

Workflow
Workflow and User mappings
Workflow, User, and Action history

We're also introducing a new permission set that allows a user to use approval APIs. This shouldn't be granted to standard users, but might be included in security-related permission sets.
Business Value:
This feature enhances transparency and control by enabling secure, read-only access to approval workflows and user actions. Businesses can leverage these APIs to build advanced auditing and compliance reports in tools like Power BI, ensuring stronger governance and accountability. Additionally, integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server opens opportunities for intelligent automation and analytics, driving efficiency and insight. By isolating permissions for API access, organizations maintain robust security while empowering authorized teams to innovate confidently.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions for representatives
items.description:
The plugin in Copilot Cowork is available out of the box for service representatives. They can use the Customer Service skills after the administrator enables the plugin for them in Cowork settings. The key capabilities are as follows:

Prioritizes and enriches cases: Surfaces highest-attention cases with suggested next actions.
Reviews for criticality and severity: Flags cases where severity mismatches actual urgency signals.
Briefs case at intake: One-screen customer, history, prior cases, and SLA snapshot.
Summarizes root cause and resolution: Proposes likely cause and ranked next-step resolutions.
Matches knowledge articles: Matches top articles, flags gaps, updates stale content.
Drafts replies: Generates template-based customer email replies for CSR review.
Handles escalations and handoffs: Detects triggers and assembles escalation packet for next owner.

Business Value:
The Customer Service plugin in Copilot Cowork helps service teams boost productivity at scale by offloading complex, multi-step case workflows. It ensures every action is grounded in the right Dynamics 365 environment and enriched with Microsoft 365 context, eliminating manual lookup.
The custom skills allow teams to tailor Cowork to their workflows, knowledge sources, and triage rules for more precise assistance. The built-in checkpoints provide human-in-the-loop governance, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and trust before any changes are committed.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Dynamics 365 Sales skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
items.description:
As an admin, you can control who can access Copilot Cowork in your organization. The Dynamics 365 Sales plugin is installed by default in Copilot Cowork and available to all users who have access to Cowork.
As a seller, you can use the sales skills in Copilot Cowork to:

Understand customer, opportunity, and pipeline context without manually gathering information from multiple systems.
Identify changes, risks, engagement patterns, and areas that require attention.
Prioritize work across customers, opportunities, leads, and pipeline activities.
Generate recommendations and next-best actions based on available business context.
Analyze business performance, pipeline health, and sales execution trends.
Support decision-making across individual, team, and organizational sales workflows.

Business Value:
If you spend the day moving between CRM, email, meetings, calendars, and collaboration tools, Dynamics 365 Sales skills bring that context together in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. By grounding Cowork in Dynamics 365 Sales data and Microsoft 365 signals, you get more relevant insights, recommendations, and actions in the flow of work. This helps you quickly understand customer relationships, opportunity health, pipeline changes, and next steps, so you spend less time gathering information and more time moving deals forward.
By combining customer, opportunity, account, lead, activity, and pipeline information with emails, meetings, calendars, and collaboration signals, Cowork can help users understand what has changed, identify what requires attention, and determine appropriate next actions.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff
items.description:
In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the permission system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.
The APIs are read-only and allow querying for:

Permission Set
Object, Scope, Extension info, and Permission Set
Permission Set and Security Group mappings
Permission Set and User mappings

We're also introducing a new permission set that allows you to use the new permission APIs. This shouldn't be granted to standard users, but might be included in security-related permission sets.
Business Value:
The new read-only permission APIs empower businesses to strengthen security and compliance by enabling external auditing and analytics without compromising system integrity. With seamless integration into tools like Power BI and Microsoft Copilot Studio, organizations can create advanced reports and intelligent agents for deeper insights. This capability enhances transparency, supports regulatory requirements, and accelerates decision-making by providing secure, real-time access to permission data. Ultimately, it helps businesses maintain robust governance while unlocking new opportunities for automation and analytics.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions across Dynamics 365 ERP
items.description:
The Copilot Cowork plugin for finance and operations apps enables users to move from business intent to insight to execution in a single experience. Copilot orchestrates work across ERP data, emails, documents, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and downstream business processes.
Key capabilities

Orchestrate workflows across ERP and Microsoft 365 data sources.
Analyze business data and generate contextual insights.
Reason across finance, operations, and supply chain domains.
Generate recommendations and prepare next steps.
Execute actions while keeping humans in the loop.

What this means for customers
The value is not just accessing ERP data through AI. Copilot Cowork enables agentic workflows where it can reason over business context, gather relevant information, evaluate options, and generate recommended actions.
This reduces manual coordination across systems, accelerates decision-making, and improves consistency in how business processes are executed.
User experience shift
Users can interact with ERP through business intent rather than navigating complex application layers and disconnected tools. This creates a more natural way to work, where users focus on outcomes instead of system interactions.
Preview scope

Initial set of scenarios across finance and supply chain.
Limited action coverage for transactional workflows.
Available to selected preview customers.

Business Value:
Enable users to move from business intent to insight to execution faster by orchestrating work across ERP data, emails, documents, and collaboration tools. Reduce manual coordination, accelerate decision-making, improve workflow consistency, and shift user time from information gathering to applying business judgment.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Analyze adherence history to optimize workforce planning
items.description:
The Adherence History Report provides a complete view of customer service representatives’ historical adherence to scheduled tasks and activities. It helps supervisors analyze patterns, identify gaps, and improve workforce efficiency.
Key capabilities
Trend chart: Visualize adherence patterns for individual service representatives or the entire team over time.
Metrics dashboard: Track adherence percentage, total scheduled time, and time spent out of adherence.
Activity summary view: Access detailed activity records for each service representative, including precise durations for granular analysis.
You can find the Adherence History Report in the Copilot Service workspace by navigating to Workforce Management in the site map and selecting Adherence Historical Analytics.
Business Value:
Organizations can gain actionable insights into customer service representative adherence behavior over time. By analyzing trends and deviations, supervisors can make informed decisions to optimize workforce planning, reduce inefficiencies, and improve service-level compliance. Using these insights helps lead to better resource allocation, higher productivity, and an enhanced customer experience.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Improve customer outcomes with Service Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is becoming a consistent way that users interact with AI across Microsoft experiences. With this update, that same chat experience is available in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with service-aware grounding and workflows.
Service users can start in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and then:

See and prioritize work (for example, top cases and what needs attention).
Draft customer communications and prepare next steps with Microsoft 365 context when relevant.
Identify trends and operational signals across cases to help supervisors and leads intervene earlier.
Discover answers from support knowledge.

Business Value:
Bring the familiar Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat experience directly into Dynamics 365 Customer Service, so supervisors, leads, and customer service representatives can get answers, summarize work, and take next steps using both Dynamics 365 data and Microsoft 365 context, without switching tools.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Unlock more Business Central data with MCP server enhancements
items.description:
With this update of the MCP server for Business Central, customers and developers can expose a broader set of Business Central APIs as tools, making it easier to build solutions that interact deeply and consistently with Business Central data and processes.
Key improvements include:
Access to all Microsoft APIs
The MCP server can now surface the full set of standard Microsoft APIs in Business Central. This enables agents and integrations to work with a wider range of entities and actions out of the box, reducing the need for custom extensions and ensuring more consistent access to business data.
Support for API queries
In addition to standard APIs, API queries are now available through MCP configurations. This allows solutions to retrieve pre-aggregated and optimized datasets directly from Business Central, improving accuracy, consistency, and performance—especially for reporting and analytics scenarios.
Business Value:
This update to the MCP server in Business Central makes it easier to build powerful, reliable integrations and agents by expanding access to Business Central data and logic. By exposing all standard Microsoft APIs, customers can reduce the need for custom extensions and accelerate development of solutions that work consistently across their business data. Support for API queries further improves results by enabling access to pre-aggregated, optimized datasets, leading to better performance and more accurate insights in reporting and analytics scenarios. Together, these enhancements help organizations build more scalable solutions, improve data consistency, and unlock greater value from Business Central as a system of record and execution.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Support average wait time in messaging API channels
items.description:
Average wait time (AWT) is now supported for custom messaging channels built using the messaging APIs, apart from live chat and voice channels.
The system computes the average wait time using an exponential moving average algorithm, giving more weight to recently connected conversations and automatically excluding abandoned ones.
Administrators and supervisors can retrieve the wait-time metric through the representative availability APIs, enabling Copilot Studio agents or custom logic to decide whether to escalate, defer, or route conversations based on real‑time queue conditions.
This enhancement ensures consistent wait‑time visibility across all supported channels, improving experience management and routing strategies.

Business Value:
Organizations using custom messaging channels built on messaging APIs can now provide customers with transparent and accurate wait‑time expectations. By surfacing estimated wait times directly through the availability APIs, contact centers can offer consistent experiences across voice, live chat, and custom channels. This helps reduce customer frustration, enables proactive decision‑making for AI agents and service representatives, and drives operational efficiency.
Enabled for:
Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Insights in Cowork and WorkIQ spend and usage
items.description: Insights into AI spend (Copilot credit usage) at a group or team level will be available in Viva Insights as a dashboard and in Advanced insights. The services in scope of this release are Cowork and Work IQ API. The dashboard experience is available to managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), the Insights analysts, and Global administrators and is enabled by default to ensure immediate access to usage-based cost insights. For users to be able to use Cowork or WorkIQ API, your tenant must have usage-based billing setup via Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Leader access to tenant-wide data is out of scope for this release. The same insights will be available for Insights Analysts and Global Administrators in Advanced Insights.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
items.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot suggested rename
items.description:
Copilot Suggested Rename is an AI-powered OneDrive feature that automatically recommends clear, descriptive file names based on a file’s content—helping users organize and find their files more easily with minimal effort. What the feature does:
- Analyzes the content of a file to generate context-aware filename suggestions
- Presents 3 recommended names directly within the rename dialog
- Allows users to pick a suggestion with a single click
Where it shows up:
- Within the rename dialog for supported files
-  Within the post-upload toast notification when a single supported file is uploaded
Supported file types:
- Microsoft Office documents
Word (DOCX)
PowerPoint (PPTX)
Excel (XLSX)
- Other document formats
PDF
Markdown (MD)
- Images

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
items.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving beyond Q&A to full task completion. These actions are powered through API plugins, MCP tools, and enterprise connectors, allowing seamless integration with line-of-business applications and services. The Copilot platform dynamically reasons over available actions and selects the appropriate tool to fulfill user intent, enabling multi-step workflows such as creating records, submitting requests, or triggering business processes within a single conversational flow

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
items.description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dynamic Tool Discovery for Declarative Agents and Federated Copilot Connectors
items.description: We're introducing dynamic tool discovery for declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
items.description:
You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.
Each agent instance tracks its own KPI metrics, such as emails received, quotes created, orders created, and time saved. The setup page is restructured to support per-instance configuration, and an upgrade path migrates existing single-instance setups to the new architecture. This change allows organizations to set up separate agents for different sales teams, product lines, or customer segments, each monitoring their own personal or shared mailbox.
Improved items search:
When a customer requests items, the agent now uses a multi-layer matching strategy:

Exact identifier match: direct lookup by item number, vendor item number, GTIN, or cross-reference.
Semantic attribute matching: extracts attributes from the customer's message (color, material, size) and ranks candidates by relevance using AI.
Broader fuzzy search: falls back to a global item search when direct and attribute-based searches produce no results.

Message and attachment relevance:
The agent now validates incoming messages and attachments against a detailed relevance model before processing. Messages that fall outside the agent's responsibilities (such as offers to sell, requests for discounts, or attempts to extract internal information) are identified and filtered.
A separate relevance check runs on attachments, ensuring that non-sales-related documents don't trigger unnecessary processing. The validation considers the full conversation history and the agent's defined scope to make accurate relevance decisions.
Larger attachment files with diagnostics.
The maximum number of pages per PDF attachment has been raised from 10 to 50, addressing customer feedback about the agent not reading larger purchase orders. A new cumulative content length limit of 150,000 characters is also enforced across all attachments in a single email (approximately 50K tokens).
When an attachment is skipped, Business Central now stores the specific reason directly on the attachment record (page count exceeded, cumulative content length exceeded, attachment count exceeded, unsupported format, or analyze-attachments not enabled). This information is visible on the Attachments page and logged in telemetry, making it straightforward to diagnose why a particular document wasn't processed.
Try it out.
You can now create tasks for the Sales Order Agent without sending an email. From the agent's setup page, a new Try it out section lets you compose a message by selecting a sender (from your contact or customer list), entering message text, and attaching files. The agent acts like it received a real email.
To help you get started quickly, two sample messages are included. One is a text-only message that references items from your catalog, and the other is a message with a sample purchase order attachment. The sample order is generated based on your actual item data, so the agent has realistic content to work with.
These samples are particularly useful for first-time setup, demos, and testing agent behavior with specific scenarios without needing to send an actual email.
Handling of unknown senders
When the agent receives an email from an unregistered email address, you now have three options instead of just one:

Create a new contact: register the sender as a new contact (existing behavior)
Use another contact once: pick an existing contact from the contact list and link them to this specific task only, without modifying any master data. The override is stored per task message and does not affect future emails.
Update an existing contact's email: select an existing contact and update their email address to the sender's address

More control over email
New configuration options give administrators more control over how the agent interacts with the monitored mailbox:

Mark email as read: a new toggle to mark processed emails as read in the mailbox. This works in addition to the custom Processed by Sales Order Agent category, giving users a visual signal in their inbox.
Mandatory folder selection: the agent now requires you to select a specific mailbox folder before activation. Previously this was optional and could lead to the agent monitoring an unexpected folder. If in doubt, choose Inbox.
Stricter activation validation: trying to activate the agent without a mailbox folder now shows a clear error message instead of allowing activation in an ambiguous state.

Prompts as embedded resources.
The agent's AI prompts (instructions, item search logic, mail template checks, irrelevance validation) are now shipped as embedded resource files within the app extension package. This change reduces latency on first task processing and makes the prompt structure more transparent for engineering iteration.
Business Value:
The Sales Order Agent now handles more complex organizational structures and higher volumes with less manual intervention. You can run multiple agent instances in one company, each dedicated to a different team or shared mailbox with independent settings and performance tracking. The agent finds the right items more reliably by understanding product attributes, informal descriptions, and identifiers across multiple matching layers.
The agent now processes PDFs up to 50 pages (previously, the limit was 10) and clearly shows why any attachment was skipped. It also filters irrelevant messages before processing, so credits aren't consumed by marketing emails or out-of-scope inquiries. If a customer writes from an unregistered email address, you can link an existing contact to that single task without creating duplicates. You can test the agent directly from the setup page without sending a real email, reducing the time to validate your configuration.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Track real project progress from field execution
items.description:
This feature enhances Dynamics 365 Project Operations by extending its native work breakdown structure effort tracking to include approved time captured in Field Service when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled and time flows in at the project task level.
Approved Field Service time now contributes directly to task-level WBS execution metrics in Project Operations when time is captured against a project task. Task metrics such as effort completed, effort remaining, percent complete, estimate at completion, and schedule variance are calculated using approved field labor under the same native project rules used for time entered directly in Project Operations.
Because these calculations occur at the leaf task level, their impact rolls up automatically to summary tasks and the project root. Effort tracking views, reprojections, and project-level status indicators reflect real execution in the field, rather than inferred progress or manual reconciliation. Project managers can assess delivery health, forecast outcomes, and identify schedule risk using execution metrics grounded in approved field work.
This enhancement doesn't introduce new execution logic or formulas. It enables existing Project Operations WBS effort tracking behavior to include Field Service execution when time is captured against project tasks.
This feature is only available when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled.
Business Value:
When field technicians complete work tied to a project task, you see that progress reflected immediately in your project health metrics. Approved Field Service time flows directly into task-level work breakdown structure (WBS) tracking in Dynamics 365 Project Operations, so effort completed, percent complete, estimate at completion (EAC), and schedule variance stay accurate without manual reconciliation.

Extract invoice data
Match vendors
Suggest lines
Create and finalize purchase invoice drafts

Trying out the Payables Agent currently requires that you configure an email connection, which is a step that creates friction before a user has even seen what the agent does. Accounts payable clerks and accountants who want to explore the agent often can't do so on their own, because setting up email often requires help from an administrator.
This feature lets any user start a Payables Agent free trial by uploading invoice files directly, with no email configuration required. Companies get a quota of 50 free invoices to experience the full agent workflow, including data extraction, vendor matching, line suggestion, and draft creation and finalization. By removing the technical barrier and the need to involve an administrator, more users can discover the agent's value firsthand and build the case for adoption within their organization.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Use enhanced customer-first direct callbacks
items.description:
Customer-first direct callback introduces a configurable, AI-powered experience managed through "callback profiles" in the Copilot Service admin center.
Administrators define a callback profile—including greeting message, alternate number capture, callback offering window, retry logic, and AI agent selection—and associate it with queues under overflow handling.
For each queue where direct callback is chosen as an overflow action, the administrator also must select a callback profile to ensure a customized callback experience for the queue.

Business Value:
Customer-first direct callback gives you a smarter way to manage customer calls. Instead of making customers wait on hold, the system initiates a callback the moment they reach the front of the line, so that they never lose their place. A prebuilt AI agent captures callback details. You can use your own AI agent to run custom workflows like customer verification. Your representatives join the call only when the customer is ready, saving time, reducing missed calls, and boosting productivity.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter the adherence tracker by planning group
items.description:
This feature provides the following capabilities:

The adherence tracker includes a planning group filter that supervisors can use to scope the view to a specific planning group.
The planning group filter works with the existing shift plan and service representative filters, so supervisors can combine filters to refine a single view.
The tracker displays representatives based on the planning groups associated with their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps the tracker aligned with the shift plan used to calculate adherence.
The tracker saves each supervisor’s filter selections across sessions and opens with their previous scope.
The tracker recalculates adherence percentages and out-of-adherence counts for the filtered scope, providing a planning group-level view of intraday adherence.
In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management > Adherence tracker.

Access and prerequisites
To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.
Business Value:
Supervising large contact centers is tough when you have to scan endless lists to find your team. Now, with planning group support, you can filter the adherence tracker to just the groups you manage. That means you spot issues faster and act right away, keeping service levels on track in real time instead of fixing problems after the fact. This feature scales for enterprise operations with hundreds of representatives and aligns with the same planning group structure you already use for forecasting, staffing, and scheduling. It saves time, reduces complexity, and helps you stay focused on what matters most: delivering consistent service.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter adherence historical analytics by planning group
items.description:
This feature provides the following capabilities:

The adherence historical analytics report includes a planning group filter that workforce managers can use to scope results to one or more planning groups.
The planning group filter works with the report’s existing filters, allowing managers to combine planning groups, date ranges, and other report parameters in a single view.
The report recalculates adherence metrics for the filtered scope, providing a group-level view of adherence performance instead of a contact center-wide aggregate.
The report associates representatives with planning groups through their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps historical reporting aligned with the shift plans used to calculate adherence.
Planning groups must be configured and have assigned representatives before the filter returns results.
In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management.

Access and prerequisites

To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.

Business Value:
Adherence only matters when it reflects how your work is organized. Until now, historical adherence reports didn’t account for planning groups, making it hard to see if performance dips came from a single under-supported queue or were spread across the operation.
With planning group support, you can focus your analysis on the groups that matter and compare adherence across them for the same time period. This gives you clearer insights and helps you make smarter staffing decisions.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

This feature enables secure, compliant management of AI agents in Microsoft Dataverse, which reduces risk and improves governance for autonomous and interactive agents.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use pick-based assignment method for work items
items.description:
Use the No auto assignment method for queues in Copilot Service admin center when you want routed conversations to remain unassigned after they enter a queue. Instead of being assigned automatically, conversations stay in the queue until a service representative picks them up from their Inbox or a supervisor assigns them manually.
This assignment method supports a pick-based work distribution model, giving supervisors and service representatives greater control over how work is handled. Unlike the push-based model used by other out-of-the-box assignment methods, which automatically assign conversations based on representative availability and capacity, the no auto assignment method allows teams to review incoming work and decide who should handle it. This approach is well suited for organizations that prefer manual oversight, specialized work selection, or supervisor-managed assignments.
Business Value:
Improve operational control and consistency by enabling service representative-led work distribution. Conversations remain available in the queue until manually assigned by supervisors or picked by representatives, helping teams handle specialized, regulated, or sensitive interactions effectively.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Speed up processing with Known Senders in Payables Agent
items.description:
This feature introduces email review policy and a Known Senders list page to give accounts payable teams more control over which incoming emails require human approval before the Payables Agent processes them.
A new Email review field in the Payables Agent setup lets administrators choose when incoming emails require human approval. The following options are available:

Always: Every email requires approval, regardless of the sender.
Never: No emails require approval.
Only if untrusted (recommended): Only emails from senders who aren't on the list of known senders require review. This is the recommended setting for most organizations.

Administrators must explicitly select an option before they start to monitor the email inbox. To ensure that they make an active decision, a default isn't preselected for the field. Every known sender is subject to a setting that sets the review policy for the specific sender.
When you set the email review policy to Manage per sender, the agent evaluates incoming emails in the following order:

Invoice is uploaded and not received via email: No review required.
Email subfolder is configured: All emails in the monitored subfolder are treated as trusted. No review required.
Sender is on the Known Senders list: Action depends on the configured value (Ask, Approve, or Reject).
Internal sender (same organization, not on the list): No review required. Internal detection uses email authentication headers (planned to be available in 2026 wave 2, version 29.0.).

Administrators can maintain a list of known senders, each with a configured policy:

Ask: The email requires human approval.
Approve: The agent processes the invoice without review.
Reject: The sender is blocked and the attachment isn't processed.

To build the list organically, after you review an email and want to continue, the sender is added automatically to the list of known senders, provided that the Manage per sender policy is active. Security telemetry is logged for each auto-addition.
This feature is available from the August minor release of 2026 release wave 1.
Business Value:
Payables Agent processes vendor invoices received by email, but today every incoming email requires supervisor approval before the agent can act on it, unless email review is disabled entirely. This creates friction for accounts payable teams who repeatedly receive invoices from the same vendors. They must manually approve each email, even from senders they already trust. The Known Senders feature lets businesses define which senders the agent can process automatically, reducing manual intervention while maintaining control over unknown or unverified sources. With this capability, organizations can safely default email review to off, moving closer to fully autonomous invoice processing.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Classify emails by category and subcategory with Case Management Agent
items.description:
With email classification, administrators can define a custom taxonomy of categories and subcategories to automatically classify inbound emails in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. AI analyzes the email subject and body, then stores the assigned category or subcategory on the email activity record. Case Management Agent, automatic record creation rules, Power Automate flows, reporting, and other downstream processes can use this value to determine how to handle the email.
Administrators can enable email classification and define category and subcategory names and descriptions. They can also set conditions that determine which emails are classified, such as specific mailboxes, sender domains, languages, and so forth. When the feature is enabled, the system qualifies inbound emails and automatically classifies them by using the Case Management Agent flow. Administrators can also manually update an assigned category or subcategory, or disable classification to stop processing new emails.
Business Value:
Email classification gives you control over how incoming emails are managed before any action is taken. It automatically sorts messages so you can ignore irrelevant ones, let the Case Management Agent handle routine issues, and focus on those that truly need human attention. This reduces clutter from non-support emails like thank-you notes, newsletters, and spam, allowing both AI and your team to concentrate on what matters most. The result is time saved, lower processing costs, and the ability to scale automated email handling confidently without adding operational risk.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Omnichannel customer experiences - Handle duplicate callback requests in overflowing queues

Prevent duplicate callback requests from the same phone number.
Define deduplication logic using combinations of caller phone number, channel phone number, and queue ID.
Configure caller experiences when a duplicate is detected. An option to end the call or play a custom message in a loop is available. For example: “You are already in queue to receive a callback when a customer service representative is available. Your latest wait time is 12 minutes. You can choose to continue waiting on this call if needed or disconnect and receive the callback.”
Specify the phone number to initiate the callback from.

Business Value:
This feature delivers significant benefits by enhancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and administrative control. It prevents redundant callback requests from the same phone number, reducing unnecessary loads on representatives and systems. Administrators gain flexibility to configure deduplication logic and tailor the caller experience, including custom messaging when duplicates are detected.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Deploy multiple Sales Qualification Agents in a single environment
items.description:

Exclusive engagement with coordinated handoff: Only one agent engages a lead at any time. When a lead's interest shifts to another product or segment, the system hands off with full context to the appropriate agent.
Shared knowledge foundation: Agents can leverage common company-level knowledge while maintaining their own specialized sources, ensuring consistent answers across the organization.
Supervisor oversight and governance: A centralized dashboard enables supervisors to monitor agent activity, reassign leads, and track the full qualification journey across all agents.

Business Value:
Multi-agent configuration in Sales Qualification Agents enables sales organizations to deploy agents aligned to distinct product lines, regions, or sales teams, each with its own qualification criteria, knowledge sources, and engagement approach. Multi-agent configuration ensures exclusive lead ownership, coordinates handoffs when context shifts, and provides sales managers with visibility across agents. This targeted approach mirrors real-world sales structures, eliminates duplicate outreach, accelerates qualification, and scales coverage without additional seller headcount.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
items.description:
Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available.
Using enterprise knowledge, configured business instructions, connectors, and custom agents, the system constructs a resolution dynamically. It generates a response that's context-aware, compliant with business rules, and tailored to the request, then delivers it directly by email—completing the interaction autonomously.
If the customer isn't satisfied or the issue can't be resolved automatically, the system creates a case that carries the full conversation context, including customer intent, actions taken, and generated responses. A service representative can then step in without losing context or duplicating work.
The capability is delivered through the Case Management Agent. An administrator enables the setting and sets the automation level for each line of business, from fully autonomous resolution to drafting a response for a service representative to review and send.
This shifts email handling from a case-first workflow to an intent-driven resolution model, reducing manual effort, improving consistency, and accelerating time to resolution for high-volume customer interactions.
Business Value:
Autonomous email resolution drives faster, consistent responses and frees service representatives to focus on complex, high-impact issues. It improves customer satisfaction and operational efficiency and scales support without increasing response times and costs by automatically resolving high-volume email inquiries.
Enabled for:

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
items.description:
AI agents in Business Central
Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to purchase orders—all reducing manual effort and freeing users to focus on higher-value work.
The agent runtime that powers these built-in agents provides core capabilities that enable the use of agentic AI within Business Central. AI agents are defined, configured, activated, and run directly inside the familiar Business Central environment—leveraging the same security model, administration tools, and user experience as the rest of the product. Results are displayed in-context, with intuitive navigation to related data and entities, allowing users to control the agents through the interface they already know. This consistency dramatically reduces the learning curve, builds trust, and ensures efficiency when working with AI agents.
The agent runtime ensures that every step taken by an agent is traceable and operates strictly within the access boundaries (permissions) assigned during configuration. It provides a timeline view of all agent activities, allowing users to review what happened and why—enabling a true human-in-the-loop experience. The runtime can also memorize relevant data during execution, use it in subsequent steps, and request additional instructions in natural language when user input is needed. It helps ensure that sensitive operations always require explicit user review and consent, supporting full transparency and control.
Business Central business processes are inherently multistep, stateful, and financially consequential. The agent layer must be able to interact with a broad set of ERP capabilities and data, sequence operations with a high degree of accuracy across dependent steps, handle the data respecting permissions, company, environment, and tenant boundaries, provide a contextual audit trail, and keep humans in the loop.
Business Central agentic strategy intentionally separates deep, well controlled, in-context and transparent execution within the product from cross-system orchestration. Business Central agents form the foundational layer inside the product, exposing well-defined agent capabilities that in the future will be possible to surface as MCP tools and consume by Declarative Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365. This layered approach enables Business Central-tuned, transparent, managed execution at the ERP core processes, while allowing higher-level Declarative Agents to orchestrate end-to-end business processes across products.
Designing agents
The new in-product experience for designing agents that automate Business Central processes is made available with AI Development Toolkit for Business Central. The experience offers a low-risk environment for envisioning and prototyping new AI agents tailored to your own business scenarios—extending the same agent runtime capabilities used by built-in Business Central agents.
Built for rapid iteration, the designing experience lets you create and refine custom agents using natural language instructions, define their behavior, test agent profiles and permissions, and safely experiment with Business Central data in a sandbox environment. This approach empowers partner personas like consultants, product owners, and domain experts, as well as developers and even power users, to explore new scenarios, validate ideas, and build confidence in their agents before moving to production. Whether you aim to automate repetitive business processes, streamline data processing, or deliver proactive insights, the agent design experience gives you the tools to bring your vision to life.
Agent instructions
At the core of every agent are its goals and instructions, defined in natural language. Writing agent instructions is similar to writing prompts for large language models, so you can apply general prompt-writing best practices—and even use tools like Copilot to optimize them. The agent design experience includes a simple editor to help you define, refine, and test these instructions efficiently.
Invoking your agent
You can invoke your agent by manually creating a task for it. When doing so, you can include an additional message that provides specific details or context to complement the agent’s core instructions. Although the ability to design your own agents is in public preview, there aren't yet any built-in integrations to automatically trigger these custom agents based on incoming emails, events, or scheduled recurrences (this can be done by professional developers using the APIs available in the AI Development Toolkit). However, you can simulate these scenarios by including the email header and body in the task message to mimic incoming emails, or by manually triggering the agent to emulate event, UI action, or time-based runs.
Troubleshooting
When running the agent tasks in the designing experience, you can access detailed diagnostic views to help you understand and tune the agent execution. Since an agent’s decisions depend on its instructions, available data, and language model reasoning, you can review execution logs to see its inputs, reasoning process, and outputs. This helps you identify where uncertainty occurred and why specific decisions were made to adjust your agent instructions.
Importing and exporting agents
To make it easy to back up or move custom agents across sandbox environments, the in-product experience allows you to import and export agent definitions. These definitions are stored as simple JSON files containing properties such as agent identity, instructions, assigned profiles, and permissions. We recommend storing these files in a source control system like GitHub to track changes and maintain version history.
Responsible AI
Agents built using the agent design experience adhere to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, helping you ensure agent compliance, fairness, and safety.
Billing
As with the built-in Sales Order and Payables agents, custom agents consume Copilot credits as they perform their steps. Credits can be provisioned through prepaid or pay-as-you-go models, providing flexible cost management as your AI usage scales.
Business Value:
Agents in Business Central are AI-powered team assistants that go beyond traditional automation. Unlike static workflows or hard-coded AL logic, agents can interpret high-level business goals expressed in natural language and translate them into actionable steps. They reason over Business Central data, make informed decisions within defined boundaries, and collaborate with users through human-in-the-loop approvals for critical operations.
The benefits are substantial: agents reduce manual effort by automating repetitive or complex tasks, allowing users to focus on higher-value activities. They adapt to dynamic business scenarios that can't always be anticipated during development, offering flexibility that traditional automation lacks. Most importantly, agents operate transparently: every action is logged, permissions are rigorously enforced, and users remain in control at all times.
This combination of intelligence, adaptability, and accountability makes agents a cornerstone of the next generation of ERP experiences. With the agent design experience, we're taking the first steps toward enabling you to build your own custom Business Central agents.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description:
Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. For example, administrators can define the intent using natural-language playbooks as follows: "If a premium customer waits for more than three minutes and no senior agents are available, increase their priority and offer a callback." Conversation orchestration then handles how it's run in real time.
You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts before anything goes live, so that you confidently publish changes without needing to test every edge case manually.
The key capabilities are as follows:

Dynamic priority escalation: In traditional systems, conversation priority is typically set once, at entry, and never revisited. This means a customer who has been waiting for 10 minutes competes for the same expert as another customer who has just arrived, and a conversation that’s transferred mid-journey resets to whatever the new queue's default priority is. Dynamic priority escalation fixes this by continuously re-evaluating priority as the conversation progresses. You define the conditions such as wait time thresholds, queue transfers, customer tier, or other context and conversation orchestration adjusts priority automatically throughout the conversation lifecycle. High-value or long-waiting customers move forward without anyone watching the queue manually.

Overflow handling across multiple conditions: Conversation orchestration supports a broader set of business triggered overflow conditions, allowing organizations to respond intelligently as queue conditions change. Administrators can define actions when a queue is outside operating hours, when all representatives in a queue are signed out or unavailable, when queue wait time exceeds a defined threshold, or when the number of waiting conversations surpasses a specified limit. Depending on the situation, orchestration can automatically offer callbacks, route conversations to alternate queues, expand assignment eligibility, notify supervisors, or deliver contextual customer messages. This ensures customers are never left waiting without a defined path forward. Admins can also configure overflow handling for direct inward dial calls now, when reps are not available or don't accept the calls.

Assign to a previously engaged or preferred representative: Customers often need to repeat information when they are connected to a new representative for every interaction. Conversation orchestration helps maintain continuity by reconnecting customers with previously engaged or preferred representatives whenever possible. Assignment decisions take into account historical interactions, queue membership alignment, representative availability, and workload capacity. For asynchronous conversations, organizations can choose to honor representative presence status and active conversation limits before reconnecting customers, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the preferred representative has capacity to engage. When the preferred or previously engaged representative is unavailable, conversations seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified representative. This reduces customer effort, improves resolution efficiency, and delivers a more personalized support experience.

Bullseye routing: Finding the right representative often requires balancing expertise with response times. Bullseye routing enables organizations to gradually expand the pool of eligible representatives when a conversation isn't assigned within a defined timeframe. Administrators can define progressive routing rings that begin with the most qualified representatives and then expand to broader groups based on skills, proficiency levels, teams, or other business criteria. This approach maximizes the likelihood of connecting customers with the best-qualified representative while ensuring conversations don't wait indefinitely for a specific resource.


These capabilities are the first in a broad and growing set of orchestration scenarios that conversation orchestration will support across the full conversation lifecycle, spanning overflow management, priority handling, assignment strategies, in-conversation messaging, and escalation. Each new capability builds on the same natural-language playbook foundation, so organizations can adopt new scenarios without rebuilding what they have already configured.
Business Value:
Traditional automatic conversation distribution systems rely on complex rules and static configuration that are difficult to maintain and can't adapt as conditions change throughout the conversation lifecycle. Unified routing with its new AI-powered conversation orchestration uses the power of agentic AI to continuously monitor events throughout the entire conversation lifecycle and responds with the right action when required.
This is a shift from a static system to an orchestration layer that remains active and intelligent from the moment a conversation arrives in a queue until it's resolved. The new feature reduces administrative complexity and helps deliver more flexible customer experiences at scale, even under fluctuating demand.
