items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Detect intraday volume spikes with workforce alerts
items.description:
Supervisors can create volume spike alerts that compare real-time conversation volume with the forecast linked to a shift plan. When volume remains above forecast for the configured number of intervals, selected recipients receive an in-app notification.
The capability includes the following features:

Administrators can enable workforce alerts in Copilot Service admin center by going to Workforce management > Intraday management > Workforce alerts.
Supervisors can create and manage alerts from Workforce alerts in the Copilot Service workspace site map.
Each alert references a shift plan and monitors the queues associated with its linked capacity plan.
Supervisors can specify the percentage by which actual volume must exceed forecast volume.
Supervisors can specify the number of consecutive intervals during which the deviation must continue before an alert is raised. The forecast determines whether an interval is 15, 30, or 60 minutes.
Supervisors can set an expiration date to limit an alert to a campaign, season, or known event.
Supervisors can select one or more notification recipients for each alert.
Active alerts are evaluated on a recurring schedule. Notifications are sent when the configured threshold and duration are met.
Recipients can select a notification to open the alert details. The details include the queue and alert name, detection time, current and forecast volumes, spike percentage, and an interval-by-interval breakdown.

Access and prerequisites

An administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from Power Platform admin center.
Forecasting and scheduling must be configured.
The selected shift plan must have a linked capacity plan and forecast.
Real-time conversation data must be available for the monitored queues.

Business Value:
Contact centers plan staffing based on forecasted demand, but actual demand can change quickly. When conversation volume rises significantly above forecast, queues can grow and service levels can decline before supervisors have time to respond.
Workforce alerts help supervisors identify unusual intraday volume changes without continuously monitoring a dashboard. Supervisors define the deviation and duration that represent a volume spike and select who should be notified when those conditions are met.
The notification provides information about the spike, including how far actual volume is above forecast and whether the deviation is continuing. Supervisors can use this information to decide whether to shift capacity, offer overtime, or defer offline work while these actions can still help protect the customer experience.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
items.description:
This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved:

Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be transferred to another available queue, ensuring a smooth end-of-day experience without manual intervention.

No service representatives are signed in: The system evaluates real-time representative availability. If all representatives assigned to a queue are signed out, it immediately triggers the configured fallback action instead of waiting for in-queue overflow timers. This is especially valuable in scenarios such as mass logout events, unexpected breaks, or holidays not captured in operating hours.


Administrators configure both scenarios using natural language prompts in conversation orchestration, enabling fine-grained control over queue behavior. This ensures customers are always routed to the best possible outcome, even when direct support is unavailable.
Business Value:
This capability ensures customers are never left waiting when representatives aren't available. Whether a queue transitions to be out-of-operating hours or all support representatives are logged out, the system proactively routes conversations to configured fallback options such as voicemail, callback, or alternative queues.
Organizations benefit from reduced wait times and lower abandonment, improved customer satisfaction during peak load or unexpected staffing gaps, and a more predictable service experience regardless of representative availability. At the same time, this eliminates the need for manual queue draining or extended shifts, helping protect service representative wellbeing while maintaining consistent service levels.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Copilot and AI innovation - Understand forecast accuracy with AI explanations
items.description:
By combining forecast results with contextual insights, planners can gain a detailed understanding of the key factors influencing each forecast rather than simply viewing the numbers. This increased transparency builds confidence and supports more informed planning decisions.
Key benefits include:

See symmetric mean absolute percentage error (SMAPE) values.
View historical data and forecast results in one place.
Understand forecast drivers through AI-generated explanations.
Gain greater confidence in planning outcomes.
Make faster and more informed business decisions.

These capabilities help planners spend less time analyzing forecast changes and more time acting.
Business Value:
Get a clear view of historical data alongside a calculated forecast supported by AI-generated explanations. This feature enhances planners' understanding of each forecast, builds confidence in the results, and enables better planning decisions.
Enabled for:
Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Monitor intraday performance against the forecast
items.description:
The intraday performance report provides supervisors with an interval-level view of performance against the forecast. In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management to access the report.

Compare forecast and actual contact volume and average handle time. Variances appear as values and percentages, making outliers easier to identify.
Compare forecast, required, and scheduled staffing levels to identify understaffed and overstaffed intervals.
Review service level, occupancy, and schedule adherence alongside volume and staffing data in a single report.
View data in 15-, 30-, or 60-minute intervals to match how your organization manages intraday performance.
Filter the report by planning group and shift plan to focus on the areas you manage.

Access and prerequisites
To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center.
Business Value:
Contact center forecasts and schedules are built days or weeks in advance, but demand rarely arrives exactly as planned. When volume spikes, handle times run long, or agents are absent, supervisors often don't see the gap until service levels have already slipped and the interval is gone.
The intraday performance report closes that gap by showing plan versus actual as the day unfolds. Supervisors can see which intervals are under- or over-staffed and act while there's still time by moving agents between queues, adjusting break and training schedules, or opening overtime only where it's genuinely needed. That protects service level and abandonment targets on the days that matter most, and it curbs the two costs that quietly compound in every contact center: paying for idle capacity in over-forecasted intervals and paying premium rates to recover from under-forecasted ones.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Assign conversation to expert who engaged with the customer previously
items.description:
Assign to a previously engaged or preferred expert leverages historical interaction context, queue membership alignment, and expert availability, to ensure customers are reconnected with experts who already understand their issue. When the previous or preferred expert is unavailable, assignments seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified expert, preserving service levels and reliability. This capability reduces repeat explanations, accelerates resolution times, and improves customer satisfaction, helping businesses lower cost to serve while delivering more consistent, personalized support experiences at scale. Administrators define assignment logic using natural language-based playbooks in conversation orchestration, with configurable lookback period to determine the time range until when the system should look for a previously engaged expert.
For asynchronous conversations, administrators can also choose to reconnect customers with the same expert by checking the expert’s current presence status and honoring active conversation limits, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the expert has capacity to engage.
Business Value:
By automatically assigning customers to a previous or preferred expert, you deliver faster, more personalized support. By routing repeat or follow up conversations to the most recent or preferred expert within configurable time windows, you reduce customer repetition, improve continuity, and accelerate resolution. When the previous expert is unavailable, the system intelligently falls back to the next best qualified expert, ensuring service levels are maintained. This leads to lower handling times, higher customer satisfaction, and improved expert efficiency.
Enabled for:
Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
items.description: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
items.description:
Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.
Building on the initial launch, planned improvements include:

Improved context handling and support for larger plans.
Higher-quality responses through model upgrades, refined prompts, and better grounding.
Greater reliability and reduced latency for more consistent, responsive interactions.
Expanded task management capabilities, including broader task assignment support.
User experience enhancements to make managing tasks and plans in Copilot Chat more intuitive.
New capabilities, including scheduled task catch-ups.

items.title: Power Apps: Manage model-driven app AI features from consolidated settings
items.description:
Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.
In Maker Studio, the Settings dialog in the model app form designer adds a new top-level Copilot and AI tab. Makers can see and adjust all available AI options for the app in one place instead of finding them scattered among all the other settings.

Data entry: Form fill assistance.
Summary: Row summaries.
Data analysis: AI-generated charts and natural-language search and filtering.

As part of this consolidation, the old model-driven app AI switches under Environment > Settings will also be retired and removed.

items.description: Sales Development Agent now integrates with Salesforce, enabling organizations to use SDA with their existing Salesforce CRM. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
items.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent
items.description:
This feature improves PO matching quality in Payables Agent and aligns draft finalization behavior with existing posting controls.
The agent uses an enriched PO Lines list page during matching that includes these fields:

Line Amount — enables matching on value, not just description and quantity. This field is especially valuable for service lines where quantity (often just 1) isn't a meaningful discriminator.
Expected Receipt Date — helps the agent factor in timing when multiple PO lines could match.

By using these fields, the agent can more reliably distinguish between similar-looking PO lines, which improves accuracy in first-pass matches.
The agent now respects the app's Never block draft finalization setting in the Receipt on Invoice field on purchase orders. This change means the agent doesn't block draft finalization because a matched PO line isn't yet marked as received. Whether goods are received is a posting time control, not a draft time control. The "Receipt on Invoice" setting on the order governs this behavior at posting.
The "Receipt on Invoice" field is already available on purchase orders. With this release, we're expanding this setting to more entities:

A new vendor-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting is introduced and automatically applied to new purchase orders created for a vendor.
A new PO-line-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting allows per-line override. The inheritance chain for the setting is vendor, then purchase order, and then purchase order line, but each level can override the parent.

We've also improved draft warnings. When the agent creates a purchase invoice draft matched to a PO, the draft surfaces warnings based not just on quantity, but also on amount. The draft warnings are for information only and don't block finalization. For example, they warn about the discrepancies in the draft and you can decide how to proceed.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Updates to Agent UI experience
items.description: Manage agents more easily by grouping avatars and using a dedicated action to start new tasks.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage agent permissions easier
items.description: Assign additional permissions to agents when they request them.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Review content generated by agents directly on pages
items.description:
This improvement introduces the ability for Business Central users to review and approve content generated by agents directly on the pages where they work. You no longer need to navigate to separate task pane to understand that a given document was created by an agent. Instead, agent‑generated suggestions—such as descriptions, text proposals, or field‑specific updates—appear inline where they can be evaluated and modified before being applied.
By keeping the review process within the page context, users maintain flow, reduce clicks, and ensure content quality with minimal disruption. The feature builds on existing Business Central autofill user interface patterns ensuring admins and users can adopt it as part of existing agent‑powered daily workflows.
Business Value:
The ability to review agent‑generated content directly on pages helps organizations streamline their daily work while maintaining accuracy and control. You can evaluate suggestions in the context of the task you are performing, reducing interruptions and improving the quality of the final output.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in list
items.description:
This feature introduces visual avatars in Business Central list pages to indicate which user or agent created or last modified a record. The capability enhances traceability and supports collaborative work by making identity information immediately visible without opening the record.
The avatars reflect either a named Business Central user, a system user or an AI agent, following the existing identity model. Users can hover over the avatar to see a tooltip with the full display name and record update timestamp (if available).
This improvement benefits roles that frequently work with shared data—including accountants, order processors, warehouse staff, service teams, and administrators—by reducing time spent verifying ownership or responsibility for items, documents, or configuration entries. It also helps organizations adopting AI‑generated records understand when an automated agent has contributed.
The feature surfaces existing Created By and Modified By fields more intuitively while respecting Business Central’s data privacy and permissions model.
Business Value:
Supporting avatars for the users or agents who created and last modified entries makes record ownership clearer and easier to understand across Business Central. By surfacing identity information directly in list pages, you can quickly determine responsibility, follow up with the right person, and work with shared data more confidently.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
items.description:
This feature introduces a dedicated task pane in Business Central that displays all tasks generated by the agents.
The task pane appears as an additional panel in the user interface and can be opened from anywhere in Business Central. Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow‑ups access to draft documents, and other agent‑initiated actions. Users can review task details, navigate directly to the affected record, complete tasks, or dismiss them.
This improvement primarily benefits roles that rely heavily on AI‑driven workflows—such as accountants, sales people, and managers—who often engage with multiple agents throughout the day. The task pane reduces friction by collecting all insights in a single location, minimizing missed tasks and improving throughput.
Business Value:
The Show all agent tasks on a separate task pane feature help organizations get more value from Microsoft Copilot in Business Central by giving users a single, structured place to review and act on AI‑generated tasks. Instead of relying on notifications scattered across different pages, users gain a clear, consolidated overview of all tasks created by agents working in finance, purchasing, sales, and operations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Enable Microsoft Copilot chat experience
items.description:
The updated Microsoft Copilot chat experience introduces a modern, consistent, and intuitive interface that aligns Business Central with the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem. The enhancement modernizes the chat panel, streamlines navigation, and improves user workflows by adopting familiar interaction patterns from Microsoft Copilot.
This update benefits users who regularly interact with Copilot to accelerate daily tasks - especially operations managers, accountants, sales representatives, and administrators who rely on conversational assistance to navigate and analyse data. It also provides a more predictable experience across Microsoft 365 applications, reducing onboarding time and helping organizations adopt AI capabilities more systematically.
Business Value:
The updated Copilot chat experience provides a familiar and consistent AI experience across Business Central and Microsoft applications. You get started faster, switch more easily between applications, and interact with AI more confidently, helping improve productivity and accelerate adoption.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run data queries with MCP Server
items.description: Use new MCP tools to define, validate, and run custom data queries. Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog
items.description: With the Skills catalog in Copilot Studio, makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent. The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description:
Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive

items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
items.description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
items.description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate

We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint.
This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs.
The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
items.description:
Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent, gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model, it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.
In the Copilot Service admin center, create a connection between Dynamics 365 and Azure. Navigate to Channels > Custom AI Voices > Connect custom voice. After the connection is established, you can create a voice channel for self-service and use the custom voice, like any portfolio voice.
Business Value:
Brand identity extends beyond visuals like logo, color, and typography, into voice. Custom neural voice enables enterprises to create a distinctive, natural sounding synthetic voice for contact centers. items.title: Power Pages: Plugin support for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code to create and edit traditional sites
items.description: The Power Pages plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code now supports creating and editing traditional (non-SPA) Power Pages sites. Developers can use natural-language prompts in their AI coding agent to create a new traditional site or download, inspect, and update existing site metadata such as web pages, web templates, content snippets, basic and multistep forms, lists, table permissions, web roles, and site settings, then upload changes back to their environment using the Power Platform CLI.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Agents and Copilot - Increase AI accuracy by grounding agents in customer insights
items.description:
The Customer Insights MCP server allows AI agents and chat experiences to access and understand insights generated by Customer Insights - Data.
The Customer Insights MCP server uses the industry-standard MCP architecture to securely share unified profiles and insights with AI agents and chat experiences, providing the data context so AI agents can do their best work.
AI tools can use the Customer Insights MCP server to:

Resolve Dataverse contacts and leads to their unified customer profile.
Access extended customer information unified by Customer Insights - Data from external sources not available to Dataverse.
Understand calculated measures for a customer such as their purchase totals over the last 4 months, or the date of their most recent engagement.
Quickly discover what segments the customer is a member of.
See if a customer has multiple redundant contacts in your system, and which is considered authoritative for that customer.
Get predictive insights for the customer such as Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and Churn risk, giving you greater insights into the customer's current relationships with your company.

Scenario
Sally is a seller who is evaluating a lead named Joe who recently attended a product launch webinar. Sally asks her AI embedded on their Contact and Lead forms if there are any insights about this lead and is delighted to find that the lead Joe is matched to a VIP customer Joseph who has existing paid licenses for several products. Because Customer Insights - Data unifies her company's external Purchase and Rewards data with Dataverse contact and lead  data, the agent informs Sally that Joe is a valued Rewards and Loyalty points member, and it is able to provide other AI-generated insights such as the Customer Lifetime Value score, Churn Risk, and the segments Joe is a member of. Armed with a wealth of customer data, Sally is able to engage Joe and upsell Joe on their new product.
Business Value:
Agents give your marketing, sales, and service teams essential insights and can automate many business processes. But agents are only as good as the data they work with. When you give them access to customer insights that unify your customer data sources, you can get more valuable and actionable insights that enable organizational efficiencies that you couldn't achieve before.
Now, more insights generated by Customer Insights - Data can be leveraged from within Microsoft Copilot Studio, allowing you to turn insights into a powerful business asset. Copilot Studio, and even your own custom copilots created in Microsoft Copilot Studio, can now simply and easily get access to more insights, allowing agents to understand, share, analyze, and act on these insights. Every team member gets tailored information and tools to reach their goals efficiently.
Enabled for:
Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent - Meeting scheduling
items.description: Sales Development Agent can turn a prospect’s interest in meeting into a booked seller meeting. The agent asks the prospect to provide preferred dates and times, evaluates those options against the appropriate seller’s calendar, and books the first valid option in the prospect’s stated preference order. The seller and prospect receive the meeting invitation, while the seller receives additional conversation context to support a warm handoff. If scheduling cannot be completed, the agent transfers the request and relevant context to the seller for follow-up.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.
Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model.
For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
items.description:
Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort.
Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, description, and sample questions — directly in the Power Apps maker portal. Search for understanding gaps and enrich missing context with a built-in glossary for domain-specific terms.
Governance and privacy built in — Enable or disable semantic signals at the org level, or at the individual signal-type or table level, giving makers and admins granular control to meet compliance and privacy requirements without sacrificing agent quality.

No manual schema mapping. No custom query logic. No disambiguation between what your data is called and what your business actually means.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
items.description:
Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage!
Powered by Engage MCP, this enhanced experience takes Copilot in Engage beyond catch-ups and summaries, helping users explore conversations more deeply, synthesize discussions, and uncover meaningful insights.
It's also more deeply connected across Microsoft 365. For example, you can ask Copilot to analyze feedback on a leader's post, identify key themes, and turn those insights into a reusable PowerPoint deck.
With Work IQ integration, Copilot also has a better understanding of you and your work context, connecting conversations in Engage to your broader work across Microsoft 365.
Engage MCP expands both the breadth and depth of Engage scenarios Copilot can support, making it more useful for understanding conversations and insights across your Engage network.
This update also brings Copilot in Engage closer to the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experience, with your Microsoft 365 agents now accessible directly within Copilot in Engage.

items.title: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork DLP
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork. This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions. items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
items.description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource.

items.description: Power Apps model-driven apps are now available as Business Apps in Work IQ. They can be accessed through the Work IQ (Preview) tool in Copilot Studio or through a natural-language chat experience powered by Work IQ MCP. In either experience, natural-language prompts let users list and read records or create, update, and delete them. For create and update, Work IQ maps supplied values to the appropriate app fields. Before a change is submitted, the proposed values require explicit user confirmation.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
items.description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat.  Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
items.description:
Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance.
Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations.
Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. items.description: Facilitator is coming to Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC. The Facilitator agent can help capture notes in real time, answers questions about the meeting, and help keep the agenda and discussion on track. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required to use Facilitator.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Author Commerce receipt formats with Copilot Cowork
items.description:
Use natural language in Copilot Cowork to create, update, translate, and check Commerce receipt layouts using existing formats in headquarters.
The Commerce receipt format designer skill lets authorized users work with receipt layouts through natural-language requests in Copilot Cowork, using receipt configuration in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters. It applies to receipt formats used by Store Commerce point of sale (POS).
Users can:

Create and adapt formats: Start from an existing format in the modern Receipt designer representation, create a new format, or request changes to an existing target.
Edit receipt sections: Modify header, line, and footer content, field positions, alignment, and supported formatting.
Translate and personalize content: Translate static labels and add user-supplied text while preserving dynamic fields. Missing business details are identified rather than invented.
Check layouts without changing them: Request structural or geometry checks that identify overlaps, width violations, and truncation risks, with findings and suggested remediation.
Verify saved changes: Review the resulting format and changes, with saved configuration re-read to confirm the requested update. Creating a format from a source preserves that source.

The skill is available automatically to authorized Copilot Cowork users. Users describe the source format and desired outcome, resolve any source or target ambiguity, and review the results. A Commerce administrator ensures appropriate headquarters access and that the source format is available in the modern structured representation.
Structural checks do not establish visual appearance, barcode scanability, runtime values, or legal and fiscal compliance. Users review the layout in the Receipt designer and perform appropriate test printing before operational use. Assigning formats to receipt profiles or printers and printing or reprinting transactions are separate setup and operational workflows.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Business performance - MCP for ERP Analytics
items.description:
MCP for Analytics provides AI agents with structured access to ERP analytics data and tools. It ensures agents use the same definitions and models as users.

Data Access: Gives agents access to ERP analytics data for analysis and insights.
Metrics and Dimensions: Provides access to key metrics, dimensions, and relationships used in reporting.
Semantic Model: Exposes the full semantic model to support consistent interpretation of data.
Tool Access: Enables agents to connect with tools like Power BI and Business Performance Analytics.

MCP makes ERP analytics data agent-ready, reliable, and explainable.
Business Value:
MCP for Analytics allows agents to access ERP analytics data and tools with context. It ensures consistency across metrics, dimensions, and hierarchies so agents can reason reliably. This improves trust in insights, reduces duplication, and simplifies development of explainable agent experiences.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Boost agent performance with optimal tool execution paths in Dynamics 365 ERP MCP

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
items.description:

Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment

The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize schedules with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description:
Dispatchers often spend considerable time and energy reviewing and adjusting each technician's schedule as conditions change throughout the workday:

A technician has one or more cancellations in the afternoon. To fill the open slots, what requirements optimally keep promise windows, prefer high-priority work, and locate work around the same neighborhoods that the technician is due to travel to?
A technician is running over the planned time for the current booking. As a result, they're late for the next booking, and the delay might cascade to subsequent bookings. How do you best adjust the bookings for the remainder of the day?
A technician recovers from illness sooner than expected and is now available for work earlier than planned. What's the best way to schedule work for them when they return?
A technician’s schedule contains a lot of low-priority work that isn't due for weeks. How can you improve the schedule with work that better meets desired business goals?
A technician’s schedule for the day is built manually or with the schedule assistant. How can you rearrange the schedule so that the resource’s travel time is reduced?

In each case, the dispatcher needs to assess the situation, determine which business goals apply, and then update the schedule manually, one booking at a time.
With this release of the Scheduling Operations Agent, dispatchers can ask Copilot to provide the best schedule for the affected technician. Within seconds, the dispatcher gets a suggested schedule for review and can apply the updates.
You can direct Copilot to optimize for the business goal you want, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority. Copilot intelligently chooses among existing bookings and new unfulfilled work orders based on factors like skillset match, territories, and customer promise windows. Users can access the feature from the Copilot side pane anywhere within the Dynamics 365 Field Service application.
Business Value:
The Scheduling Operations Agent for Dynamics 365 Field Service enables dispatchers to quickly and easily optimize schedules for technicians as conditions change throughout the workday, so they can significantly improve their productivity. Dispatchers can ask Copilot to optimize schedules and address issues such as traffic delays, double bookings, or last-minute cancellations that often result in conflicts, gaps, or idle time in a technician's schedule. Instruct Copilot to achieve the desired business objective, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority while considering factors like skillset match, territories, and promised time windows.

The tools enable agentic experiences to look up the original purchase using supported identifiers such as receipt, order, invoice, or confirmation number; retrieve matching transactions and returnable lines; identify items that are returnable, partially returnable, already returned, or not returnable; create a return using selected lines, quantities, and reason codes; determine eligible refund options for original-tender refund scenarios; and execute eligible original-tender refunds through existing Commerce return and payment logic.

Setup is performed by an administrator, IT owner, or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent or integration to call the tools, and maintain existing Commerce return policies, reason codes, tender rules, and payment configuration.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
items.description:
Using the AI resources provides several benefits:

Reduced operational overhead: Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers.
Simplified onboarding: Quickly integrate AI capabilities into your solutions without having to navigate the complexities of setting up and managing your own Azure OpenAI subscription.
Improved reliability: Proactive scaling, throttling, load balancing, and fault tolerance measures ensure consistent performance during peak demand.
Enhanced security compliance: Built-in compliance measures and governance, including robust protection from malicious and harmful content, ensure compliance with data residency requirements. This benefit reduces the burden of ensuring regulatory compliance for ISVs.
Streamlined experience for customers: Customers get a seamless AI resource management process without maintaining different configurations for separate ISV solutions.

This capability also provides a cohesive AI consumption tracking and billing experience for Business Central customers. Customers who use AI resources across multiple AI-enabled solutions built with Business Central customer developer tools for Copilot benefit from a unified approach to AI consumption monitoring and invoicing. They don't need to reconcile multiple invoices or metrics from separate ISVs.
For details on billing costs, see AI tools at Message scenarios.
For most publishers, the default Business Central AI resources are enough. However, if you need specific models, including fine-tuned models, that the Business Central AI resources don't provide, you can bring your own subscription for customers. In this case, the publisher is responsible for deploying, maintaining, scaling, and securing the service. The publisher also handles billing AI resources to customers.
We recommend using the developer toolkit AI resources when you extend Copilot in Business Central. You just need to authenticate with the SetManagedResourceAuthorization method in the AI Module AzureOpenAI codeunit. You also provide your own Azure OpenAI subscription details, but the authentication process doesn't use them. (Update 2026 release wave 1: There's now a new method signature for SetManagedResources that doesn't require you to provide your subscription details anymore. You should use that going forward.)
// Example of using the default toolkit AI resources in AL 
AzureOpenAI.SetManagedResourceAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",AzureOpenAIAccountName,AzureOpenAIApiKey,AOAIDeployments.GetGPT4oLatest());

To use your own subscription, authenticate it with the SetAuthorization method.
// Example of using your own Azure OpenAI subscription in AL 
AzureOpenAI.SetAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",GetEndpoint(),GetDeployment(),GetApiKey());

This AI billing model isn't designed to replace the existing Marketplace monetization pathway for publishers who create Business Central apps. Instead, it offers another option that simplifies AI consumption for customers and partners. ISVs can use the Marketplace monetization option to monetize their IP.
Business Value:
A key feature of the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central is that publishers in their Marketplace apps use large language models through Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI resources when they extend Copilot in Business Central. This approach eliminates the need for customers to independently get and manage Azure OpenAI subscriptions. Using the Business Central AI resources is the default and recommended approach. However, some partners or customers might have special requirements that require them to use their own Azure OpenAI subscription when running the feature in production or when developing and testing in sandboxes, which is also supported in the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Improve engagement and message timing with Outreach Optimization Agent
items.description:
Add the Outreach Optimization Agent to your journey, select the emails you want delivered, and let the agent handle timing and cadence automatically. With Outreach Optimization Agent, you can:

Start with an intelligent baseline: Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns, producing a smart, generic plan that is designed to work well for most customers before any individual optimization kicks in.
Listen to incoming interactions and adapt the plan in real time: The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved.
Respect quiet times: The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows, even if engagement data suggests otherwise.

Scenario
A global retail brand uses Outreach Optimization Agent in a seasonal campaign to re-engage customers. Unlike previous efforts with fixed schedules and repeated reminders, the agent creates a smart baseline plan, then adjusts message timing for each customer based on their engagement. It slows or stops follow-ups when customers show interest and spaces out reminders for unresponsive customers, all while respecting quiet times and consent. This leads to better engagement and less message fatigue, with minimal manual intervention.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Clone and share Sales Development agent configuration across teams
items.description:
As a sales leader, you can configure a Sales Development agent once, then share or clone its configuration across your organization. Distribute the agent’s playbook, guidelines, guardrails, and settings to other business units to provide a consistent experience across sales teams.
The feature supports these capabilities:

Export a configuration: In Teams, ask the source agent to package its configuration into a file. For example, enter Export your configuration.
Import a configuration: Attach the exported file to a new agent, then ask the agent to apply the configuration.
Create a one-time copy: The copied configuration is a snapshot, not a synchronized connection. Changes made later to the source agent aren’t automatically applied to the target agent.

Knowledge sources, such as uploaded documents, FAQs, and URLs, aren’t included in the exported configuration. Add them directly to the target agent after importing the configuration.
Business Value:
Scaling your sales operations just got easier. Instead of manually configuring each Sales Development agent from scratch, you can now set up an agent once with your organization's best practices and guardrails, then share or clone it across your entire team. This means faster deployment, consistent outreach to prospects, and more time for your sellers to build relationships instead of repetitive work. Whether you're expanding to new markets or rolling out agents across multiple business units, you'll maintain quality and compliance while reducing the time it takes to get your agent up and running.
